controles.affirmation: Aucune procedure judiciaire materielle declaree ; les frais lies a des litiges augmentent
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, note Litigation : "We are subject to various legal proceedings arising both in and outside of the ordinary course of our business. We are not presently a party to any legal proceedings that it believes, if determined adversely to the Company would have a material adverse effect on the Company." L'ATT ne parle jamais d'enquete ni de poursuite : elle se limite aux "frais lies a des litiges", ce que le document confirme.

controles.affirmation: Reserves de pertes constituees en 2025 pour deux agences etatiques, litiges contractuels potentiels
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "The decrease of 9% in the PT segment operating income in 2025 is primarily due to loss reserves of approximately $10.7 million for two state contracts, primarily impacting lower revenue from professional services" ; "Professional services revenue decreased 8% compared to the prior period. The decrease is primarily due to loss reserves related to agencies within two state governments." ; ES : "a loss reserve of approximately $9.7 million of remaining exposure related to a contract dispute previously disclosed".

controles.affirmation: Gain non recurrent de 25,0 M$ ; resultat avant impots 120,6 M$ (+17,7 %) ; 95,6 M$ hors gain, soit -6,8 % contre 102,5 M$
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "The Company recognized a gain of $25.0 million as a result of remeasuring the previously held equity investment to its fair value on acquisition date." Compte de resultat : "Gain on remeasurement of equity investment 25,048" ; "Income before income taxes 120,631 / 102,513". Note fiscale : "a nontaxable gain on remeasurement of equity investment". Acquisition FTR : "The total consideration in the acquisition was $257.8 million". Calculs verifies : +17,7 % ; 95,583 vs 102,513 = -6,8 % ; revenus T2 637 189 vs 588 551 = +8,3 %.

controles.affirmation: Marge operationnelle 14,7 % au T2 2026 contre 16,0 % au T2 2025 ; 15,5 % contre 15,9 % sur six mois
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, tableau "Percent of Total Revenues" : "Operating income 14.7 / 16.0 / 15.5 / 15.9".

controles.affirmation: Frais de services professionnels en hausse de 6,9 M$ AU T2 2026 a cause de frais lies a des litiges
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "For the six months ended June 30, 2026, the G&A expense increase is attributable to a $6.9 million increase in professional services primarily from litigation-related expenses, a $4.7 million write-off of previously capitalized software projects..." Pour le trimestre seul, le document indique un montant different : "For the three months ended June 30, 2026, the increase in G&A expense was primarily attributable to a $7.1 million increase in professional fees primarily from ligation-related expenses".
controles.correction_proposee: Les 6,9 M$ portent sur les SIX MOIS, pas sur le trimestre. Ecrire : "les frais de services professionnels ont augmente de 6,9 M$ sur six mois (7,1 M$ sur le seul deuxieme trimestre), principalement a cause de frais lies a des litiges". Le write-off de 4,7 M$ est bien un chiffre semestriel, ce que l'ATT indique correctement ailleurs.

controles.affirmation: Goodwill en hausse de 6,4 % SUR UN AN (2 754,7 M$ contre 2 590,0 M$)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, bilan consolide : colonnes "June 30, 2026 (unaudited)" et "December 31, 2025". "Goodwill 2,754,742 / 2,590,013". Il s'agit donc d'une variation sur SIX MOIS (31 decembre 2025 -> 30 juin 2026), pas sur douze mois.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire : "le goodwill a augmente de 6,4 % en six mois, de 2 590,0 M$ au 31 decembre 2025 a 2 754,7 M$ au 30 juin 2026".

controles.affirmation: Licences perpetuelles -51 % et services professionnels -8 % en 2025 dans le cadre de la transition vers le SaaS
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "Software licenses and royalties revenue decreased 51% compared to the prior period primarily due to a loss reserve for remaining exposure related to a contract dispute previously disclosed. The remainder of the decline is due to the ongoing shift in the mix of new software contracts toward more SaaS offerings." ; "Professional services revenue decreased 8% compared to the prior period. The decrease is primarily due to loss reserves related to agencies within two state governments."
controles.correction_proposee: Les pourcentages sont exacts mais la cause principale indiquee par le document n'est PAS la transition SaaS : c'est une reserve de pertes sur un litige contractuel (licences) et des reserves de pertes sur deux agences etatiques (services professionnels), la transition SaaS n'etant citee que comme cause secondaire. Reformuler : "licences logicielles -51 % et services professionnels -8 % en 2025, principalement sous l'effet de reserves de pertes sur un litige contractuel et sur deux contrats etatiques, la transition vers le SaaS n'expliquant que le reste du recul".

controles.affirmation: Dette obligataire prise apres des annees quasi sans dette
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, tableau de dette : "Convertible Senior Notes due 2026, 0.25 %, March 2026 : - (30 juin 2026) / 600,000 (31 decembre 2025)". La societe portait donc 600 M$ d'obligations convertibles avant cette emission. "On March 15, 2026, we repaid the $600.0 million aggregate principal amount of its 0.25% Convertible Senior Notes due 2026 in cash at maturity."
controles.correction_proposee: La societe n'etait pas "quasi sans dette" : elle portait 600 M$ d'obligations convertibles, mais sa tresorerie les couvrait (dette nette quasi nulle). Ecrire : "la societe passe d'une dette de 600 M$ integralement couverte par sa tresorerie a 1,44 Md$ d'obligations convertibles, superieurs a la tresorerie disponible". La formulation du bloc quantitatif ("quasiment sans dette nette") est, elle, exacte.

controles.affirmation: 1,44 Md$ d'obligations convertibles 2031 a 0,50 %, prix de conversion 405,94 $, ligne de credit de 1,0 Md$, dette 1 437,5 M$ contre 895,4 M$ de tresorerie, flux operationnel semestriel 231,7 M$
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "On May 14, 2026, we issued 0.50% Convertible Senior Notes due in 2031 for the aggregate principal amount of $1.44 billion" ; "an initial conversion price of approximately $405.94 per share" ; "the average market price of our common stock was below the conversion price" ; "On May 28, 2026, we entered into a $1.0 billion credit agreement" ; tableau de dette "Total borrowings 1,437,500" ; bilan "Cash and cash equivalents 895,353" ; flux "Net cash provided by operating activities 231,673".

controles.affirmation: Segment Platform Technologies -2,35 % sur six mois (308,9 M$ contre 316,4 M$), +4 % au T2, apres l'arret d'un contrat etatique de traitement de paiements
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, note segments : "Total segment revenues ... 308,920" (6 mois 2026) contre "316,365" (6 mois 2025) ; T2 2026 160,857 contre T2 2025 154,636 (+4,0 %). MD&A : "a decline of approximately $24.8 million in transaction-based revenues, partially offset by a corresponding $21.5 million reduction in merchant fees, following the wind-down in the fourth quarter of 2025 of a state payment processing contract".

controles.affirmation: Quatre acquisitions en 2025 (Edulink, CloudGavel, Emergency Networking, MyGov) ; rotation client d'environ 2 %
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : acquisitions d'Edu.Link (2 decembre 2025), CloudGavel (19 novembre 2025), Emergency Networking (28 juillet 2025) et MyGov (31 janvier 2025) ; "During 2025, based on our number of clients, attrition was approximately 2%."
